set.body:
Why: the CPCA constraint is encoded three ways — CpcaConstraintKind (tag, Cpca.scala:6-9), CpcaConstraintSpec (declarative, :122-125), and CpcaConstraint (resolved trait, :258) — with a .kind discriminator (:259) that can drift from the actual subtype. isZeroBlock switches on .kind while coordinates matches the subtype directly.

Scope: one CpcaConstraint enum (Identity | Zero | Basis) with resolve/project/residual/coordinates as methods; drop CpcaConstraintKind and every .kind read.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] CpcaConstraintKind deleted; no .kind field remains.
- [ ] All call sites (isZeroBlock, coordinates, ...) pattern-match the enum exhaustively.
- [ ] CpcaSuite passes unchanged on JVM+JS.
set.title: multivar: collapse CPCA constraint triple-encoding to one enum
